parameters.query:
SELECT nome, telegram_chat_id, whatsapp FROM (
  SELECT u.nome, u.telegram_chat_id, u.whatsapp, 0 AS ordem FROM nucleo.usuarios u
   WHERE coalesce($2,'') = '' AND u.id = $1::int
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.nome, c.telegram_chat_id, c.whatsapp, length(c.nome) FROM nucleo.contatos c
   WHERE coalesce($2,'') <> '' AND c.ativo AND c.nome ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
     AND (c.usuario_id = $1::int OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nucleo.usuarios a WHERE a.id = $1::int AND a.papel = 'admin'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.nome, u.telegram_chat_id, u.whatsapp, 1000 + length(u.nome) FROM nucleo.usuarios u
   WHERE coalesce($2,'') <> '' AND u.ativo AND u.nome ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
) d ORDER BY ordem LIMIT 1
